data.one_liner: A kit of useful functions and widgets to speed up development.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of helpful utilities, extensions (like DateTime operations), data validation rules, and widgets to speed up common development tasks. It also supports localizations for messages and errors.
use_when: You want common utility functions, extensions, and datetime operations in your project
You need form validation rules and two-way binding capabilities
You want helper widgets like Spacing or CourtesyWidget
avoid_when: You only need a single lightweight function already available in Dart or another targeted package
You want a fully-fledged state management library
strengths: Includes useful datetime extensions and iterable operations
Provides data validation rules and TwoWayBinding utilities
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and desktop
weaknesses: Broad scope may introduce unnecessary utilities if only a few are needed
Limited documentation outside of basic file lists
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and plug the localization delegate into your MaterialApp if using localizations.
